title: Architect
description:
Result of Service

The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, an Architect is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Architect will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities:
• Review of Program, layout, 3D modeling, façade elements, and preliminary architectural design.
• Analyze and review basic architectural projects, regarding aspects of dimensioning, urbanism, thermal comfort, ventilation, acoustics, energy efficiency, specifications of materials.
• Prepare reports and technical analysis on basic architectural projects.
• Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards.
• Apply advanced analysis techniques to propose solutions to problems related to architecture and compatibility of projects.
• Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, engineers, and architects.
• Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project.
• Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team.
• Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Architect shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Architectural Preliminary Design Description: A consortium will design the architectural preliminary design, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 80 days after signing the contract. Product 2: Basic Architectural Design Description: A consortium will design the basic architectural design, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 160 days after signing the contract. Product 3: Use, Operation, and Maintenance Manual Description: A consortium will design the manual, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 240 days after signing the contract. Product 4: Compatibility inspection – Area 1 and 2 Description: A consortium will design compatibility studies, and the Architect will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Architecture, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Architecture. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in basic projects for housing solutions in Brazil is required.
• Experience in architectural projects for social housing is required.
• Experience in urbanistic, and landscaping projects for informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
• Experience and skills in using BIM are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable. The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze, review, and, when necessary, suggest adjustments in drainage basic projects and ensure compatibility with sewage and water network projects designed by the local concessionaires. b) Prepare reports and technical assessments on drainage projects. c) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards. d) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, and engineers. e) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. f) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. g) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Drainage projects – Area 1 Description: A consortium will develop drainage projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 65 days after signing the contract. Product 2 - Drainage projects – Area 2 Description: A consortium will develop drainage projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 130 days after signing the contract. Product 3 – Drainage projects – Area 3 Description: A consortium will develop drainage projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 195 days after signing the contract. Product 4 – Drainage analysis for degraded areas recovery plan Description: A consortium will design a recovery plan, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 260 days after signing the contract. Product 5 – Drainage analysis for environmental assessment Description: A consortium will design an environmental analysis, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Civil Engineering or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related fields. Work experience:
• At least six (6) years of professional experience in sanitation engineering roles is required, especially related to drainage and sustainable urban drainage design.
• Experience in the use of nature-based solutions is desirable.

• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD Civil 3D is desirable. Competencies

• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management

• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages

O objetivo deste cargo é atuar na implementação da auditoria contínua na companhia e também executar auditorias internas de maior complexidade em todas as áreas da empresa.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Reunir dados relevantes;

  • Compreender os objetivos de negócio para extração de dados relevantes;
  • Automatizar documentos para uso recorrente;
  • Montar relatórios, dashboards, análise, apresentação de resultados;
  • Participar de reuniões de levantamento das metas e objetivos;

Requisitos e qualificações

Superior Completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Banco de Dados ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência de no mínimo 01 ano como Analista de BI.

VAGA DIARISTA, SEM POSSIBILIDADE DE CONCILIAR COM OUTRO EMPREGO.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão


A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

title: atendente de drogaria
description:
Endereço
R SENADOR DANTAS, 5, CENTRO - Rio de Janeiro, RJ

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?
Na DPSP (lojas, CDs e corporativo), nosso trabalho impacta a saúde e o bem-estar de milhões de brasileiros todos os dias. Nossa força está nas pessoas que colocam saúde em primeiro lugar, atuam com ética, colaboração e respeito às diferenças. Junte-se a nós e seja protagonista na transformação da jornada de saúde de quem confia na gente.

Mais do que igualdade, buscamos equidade: Aqui, temos espaço para sermos autênticos, independentemente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, credo ou deficiência. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD). #VemSerDPSP

O Grupo DPSP valoriza a sua Privacidade e a Proteção dos seus dados pessoais. Em caso de dúvidas sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais no processo de atração e seleção, acesse nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos:

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

Quais serão os seus desafios por aqui?

  • Atender o público com empatia, agilidade e cordialidade;
  • Demonstrar e apresentar produtos, contribuindo para uma experiência de compra encantadora;
  • Realizar a reposição de mercadorias, mantendo a loja sempre abastecida;
  • Garantir a organização e limpeza da loja;
  • Atuar no fechamento de caixa;
  • Apoiar nas demais atividades do dia a dia da loja e do time de vendas.

Requisitos

O que consideramos importante para que você faça parte do nosso time?

  • Ter 18 anos ou mais;

  • Ensino médio completo.

  • Espírito colaborativo, boa comunicação e disposição para trabalhar em equipe;

  • Foco no cliente: entender sua jornada e buscar soluções que proporcionem uma experiência única e personalizada;
  • Proatividade, iniciativa e praticidade para lidar com os desafios do dia a dia.

Não é necessário ter experiência Valorizamos sua vontade de aprender e crescer com a gente.

Benefícios

  • Academia / Práticas Esportivas
  • Assist. Médica
  • Assist. Odontológica
  • Desconto em Produtos
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Universidade Corporativa
  • Vale-Refeição
  • Vale-Transporte

Observações e/ou Benefícios Adicionais

  • Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR);

  • Cesta básica com 4 opções diferentes, para você escolher a que mais combina com sua rotina;
  • Cesta de Natal para celebrar o fim de ano com mais sabor;
  • Suporte em Saúde Mental: cuidado com o que realmente importa;
  • Convênios com empresas parceiras: descontos e vantagens exclusivas;
  • Plano de Carreira: crescimento profissional feito junto com você.

Sobre a Organização
Estamos há mais de 130 anos presentes no dia a dia dos brasileiros.

A nossa história como Grupo DPSP começa lá em 2011, com a fusão dessas redes de farmácias.

E desde então, os nossos mais de 30 mil colaboradores constroem novos capítulos dessa história diariamente, levando soluções de saúde para as milhares de pessoas que frequentam as nossas mais de 1.600 lojas e 6 centros de distribuição espalhados em 9 estados do Brasil e Distrito Federal.

E isso é só o começo

title: Enfermeiro Oncologia
description:
Requisitos:

  • Graduação Plena Completa em Enfermagem, com COREN ativo;
  • Pós-graduação em Oncologia;
  • Experiência em Oncologia;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas e protocolos de enfermagem voltados para oncologia;
  • Habilidades de liderança, comunicação efetiva e trabalho em equipe;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em diferentes unidades da MedSênior no Rio de Janeiro, conforme necessidade do setor;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em escala de segunda à sexta de 7h às 17h.

Atividades:

  • Executar o protocolo de tratamento, checando informações como o peso e altura, doses de medicações e medicações de suporte para a quimioterapia, conhecidas como "pré-QT" a fim de agir com segurança;
  • Elaborar protocolos terapêuticos de enfermagem na prevenção, tratamento e minimização dos efeitos colaterais em clientes submetidos ao tratamento quimioterápico antineoplásico;
  • Efetuar e assegurar os registros dos procedimentos e intercorrências relacionadas ao paciente, nos prontuários, de acordo com o SAE, considerando os aspectos técnicos, éticos e legais;
  • Realizar a revisão dos prontuários evidenciando registros, documentos dos pacientes e exames, verificando sua organização, conforme rotina definida;
  • Acompanhar transferências de casos graves às unidades / exames específicos ou tratamentos;
  • Receber e passar o plantão, diariamente, munindo o enfermeiro sobre quaisquer intercorrências e informações necessárias relativas aos pacientes, familiares / acompanhantes, equipe e setor, inclusive as pendências, visando assegurar a continuidade da assistência de enfermagem;
  • Orientar paciente / família quanto aos tratamentos terapêuticos, riscos assistenciais e medidas preventivas, utilizando práticas relacionadas às condições do paciente;
  • Avaliar a necessidade de acionamento do TIRR – Código amarelo, de forma fidedigna, informando os dados do paciente, bem como a assistência adequada e preenchimento correto dos formulários;
  • Controle da fila de regulação de quimioterapia.

Tipo de vaga: Tempo integral, Temporário

Pagamento: R$5.000,00 - R$5.946,67 por mês

Se você quer atuar como Engenheiro de Otimização da Produção Especialistatemos um novo desafio para você

Principais responsabilidades:

Garantir a extração eficiente, segura e sustentável de petróleo e gás natural, aplicando princípios avançados de engenharia para otimizar a produção, reduzir custos e minimizar impactos ambientais. O engenheiro de produção atua como elo estratégico entre tecnologia, reservatório, operações e gestão, assegurando que os recursos energéticos sejam explorados de forma responsável e alinhada às normas regulatórias.

  • Monitorar e gerenciar operações de produção, garantindo a implementação de processos e procedimentos adequados.
  • Utilizar e promover estratégias para atendimento dos requerimentos dos consumidores.
  • Desenvolver e aplicar planos para otimização da produção, intervenções para melhora do desempenho de poços.
  • Analisar e interpretar dados operacionais, reservatório, geologia, petrofísica, poços, e grandes bases de dados integrais dos ativospara identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas e processos avançados para aumentar a eficiência e potenciais de produção, e analise de flow assurance.
  • Dar suporte técnico às equipes de operação e reservatório nos aspectos de otimização de poços e produção, surveillance da produção, elevação e escoamento.
  • Aprimoração de Ferramentas Digitais e Aplicação de inteligência artificial para diagnóstico, otimização de poços e da produção
  • Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança, ambientais e regulatórias.
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos sobre desempenho e propor ajustes para maximizar monetização e utilização de reservas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar melhores práticas e inovações na área de E&P.
  • Interagir ativamente com profissionais da área de E&P, departamentos de suporte e órgãos em busca das alternativas de otimizar a produção e equipamentos envolvidos na extração.
  • Participar de iniciativas processos de Excelência Operacional, desenvolvimento de ferramentas para acompanhamento de projetos e portfolio;
  • Articular com as áreas de reservatório/exploração para o acompanhamento e execução do plano de desenvolvimento do campo e gerenciamento da produção, para garantir o progresso do projeto;
  • Contribuir para alcançar metas do projeto e identificar recursos, processos, stakeholders e riscos associados;
  • Facilitar a visibilidade e coordenação do projeto com as partes interessadas internas e externas;
  • Utilizar softwares e outras ferramentas para realizar análises e avaliações relacionadas à qualidade das decisões e desenvolvimento do projeto;

  • Atuar como ponte entre contabilidade, gestão e áreas técnicas, apoiando boas práticas e governança.

O que esperamos de você

  • Formação superior em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência entre 3 e 5 anos em rotinas contábeis e/ou financeiras, com uso de ERP.

title: TMF Officer
description:
The Research and Development Department includes three clusters of disease expert teams NTD Mycetoma and Leishmaniasis; NTD Chagas, Filarial, and HAT; and Viral Diseases. These teams drive therapeutic innovation from the lab bench to the patientbedside, advancing DNDi's portfolio of treatment candidates from the outset (with the design of target product profiles) to theend point (enabling patients' access to new treatments).

DNDi established its Latin American office in Rio de Janeiro in 2004. Since then, DNDi Latin America has made extensive contributions to advancing R&D and access partnerships across the region's diverse health ecosystems. Its work spanning neglected diseases such as Chagas disease, leishmaniasis, hepatitis C, and dengue plays a central role in delivering DNDi's global strategy. The office also leads advocacy efforts and drives capacity-building initiatives through multi-country clinical research and drug discovery platforms.

The Trial Master File Management Officer is responsible to compile, maintain and archive all TMF related documents in order to prepare the submissions to any international authorities for one or several different drug registrations and to comply with DNDi's SOPs and GCP requirements for filing and archiving of clinical trials. The incumbent will plan and coordinates the overall management of the Trial Master Files and associated processes following GCP and ICH, including system and tool development, business process documentation and is ultimately responsible to ensure inspection readiness for the TMF across all Disease

Programme/Cluster.

  • Manage document control processes and systems for GCP activities in compliance with internal procedures and policies and ensure compliance with ICH/GCP and relevant international and local legislation and regulations.
  • Assess suitability of documentation for filing (accuracy, completeness, and legibility).
  • Ensure high quality Trial Master File set-up and management (on-boarding of study contributors, completion of the Trial Master File management plan, study specific preparation of documents in the system, periodic reviews, etc.).
  • Serve as a Trial Master File contact for documentation to the project team and cross functional departments
  • Follow up on open record management queries and ensure their full resolution.
  • Assist in periodic Trial Master File audits.
  • Plan and perform internal periodic quality check activities of the Trial Master File, provide findings to the clinical team and provide support to the team to ensure compliance is maintained to meet internal and external quality standards.
  • Provide support to clinical teams during regulatory inspections for record organization and retrieval.
  • Continuously monitor, identify and report quality problems and record management work practices, make

recommendations for resolutions, and initiate actions required to resolve quality and efficiency problems.

Additional /specific/projects Responsibilities

  • Support the creation and/or update of applicable SOPs, Guidance Documents, templates etc., as applicable.
  • Continuously oversee and identify rooms for improvement for document management processes, in particular in the areas of archiving management. Support implementation activities as applicable.
  • TMF Officer reports to Senior Clinical Project Manager.
  • Works with all teams, and all units in the all departments.
  • Coordinate with external contacts under supervision. Support information exchange.
  • First university degree (Bachelor level) in a relevant field if required by the function.
  • At least 3 years of experience or equivalent internship/training in the area.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and matrix structure.
  • Experience working in the public and private sector is highly desirable.

Critical Skills And Attributes

  • Emerging technical skills in a defined field.
  • Ability to support standard and routine activities independently.
  • Willingness to learn and apply feedback to evolve into higher-level specialist roles.
  • Ability to use initiative, prioritize, multi-task, and work well under pressure to meet deadlines.
  • Clear and systematic thinking that demonstrates good judgment and problem solving competencies.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multicultural team.
  • Well organized and structured.
  • Good analytical skills.
  • Provide specialist services to operational line or project team.
  • Ability solve non-routine problems on a case by case/project basis.
  • Has certain autonomy for taking actions and decisions.

R& D Technical Skills

  • Good Knowledge of regulatory (GCP, GLP and GMP) particularly in TMF management.
  • Strong Technical writing skills (procedures, protocols and reports.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Proficiency in local languages desirable.
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Suite.
  • Good knowledge of Veeva (eTMF maintenance, improvement, review release, set-up, etc…. ).

DNDi is committed to building a diverse, equitable and truly inclusive organisation. Our success and global reach are dependent upon our ability to encourage diversity and draw on the skills, understanding and experience of all our people. We particularly welcome applications from those who are underrepresented in at DNDi and across the sector, especially women, and including, but not limited to, black and minority ethnic candidates, and those with other protected characteristic.

É isso que nos move e nos faz ir além, todos os dias

title: Laboratory Supervisor
description:
JOB PURPOSE

This position is accountable for providing expertise to customers, related to all aspects of a project from sample collection protocols to analysis requirements needed to meet criteria of project, to QC and reporting of data in the geological services lab. The Geologist must be available to execute petrographic descriptions, data integrations with generated data and discuss results with customers, also provide interpretive reports when necessary.

QHSSE

Required to follow all QHSSE and Compliance policies and procedures and complete training by using all systems as defined by Stratum. You are responsible for creating opportunities for improvement, report and investigate incidents, non-conformities, and operative issues. Employees must submit STAR cards and report any risks identified on the job. Participation in meetings and general activities created to help in prevent risks is required. The employee is responsible to stop the job and assess whether the conditions are safe to continue work. If applicable, must be responsible for completing all required QHSSE and Compliance reporting.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Schedule, coordinate and organize personnel to execute the geological services.
  • Generate QC to the Thin sections elaborated on the TS Lab.
  • Generate Thin Section descriptions, mainly presalt samples.
  • Data Integration and QC within Thin section description, XRD, XRF, LPSA,
  • Generate interpretive reports and give presentations based on geological analysis.
  • Coordination between clients and laboratory personnel and management to receive, execute and/or send the samples abroad.
  • Attend meetings with clients for projects follow up and/or present the services.
  • Request materials and maintenance to complete the jobs in a timely matter.
  • Report generated revenue according Stratum policies and required dates.
  • Travel to conferences, training or support may be required on occasion in and outside of Stratum companies.
  • Must understand and comply with all safety rules and company policies of Stratum.
  • Know and understand Stratum Quality Policy and comply with all requirements of the Quality Systems Manual, Operating and Technical Procedures and Workplace Instructions.
  • Coordinate with other staff/labs to ensure samples are completed in a timely manner, and that proper protocols are followed.
  • Perform various other duties and activities as assigned by supervisor within the physical constraints of the job.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Petrographic descriptions
  • Personnel Management
  • English and Portuguese languages

Minimum Qualifications:

Essential

  • BSc Geology or related

Preferred

  • 7+ years' experience

title: Estagiário de Arquitetura
description:
No Grupo Trigo, a gente leva a sério a missão de conquistar corações através do estômago

Somos uma das maiores rede de franquias do Brasil, a turma por trás de marcas incríveis como Spoleto, Koni, Gendai, China in Box, Le Bonton, Gurumê e 2V Deli & Conveniência.

Uma empresa que nasceu com o propósito de democratizar a boa culinária e que está crescendo em um ritmo muito acelerado. Quer saber um pouquinho mais sobre a nossa história? Aproveita e dá uma lida no resuminho que tem ali embaixo ;)

Vamos ao que interessa?

Se você curte um ambiente descontraído, ama inovação e aprender coisas novas, o Grupo Trigo é o seu lugar. Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) de Arquitetura para integrar o time de Projetos do Grupo Trigo. A posição atuará com suporte direto nos Estudos de Viabilidade para projetos de implantação de novos negócios e reformas.

E aí, se identificou? Não hesite em se candidatar agora mesmo.

  • Atualizar controles, planilhas e status dos projetos na plataforma oficial;
  • Dar suporte à comunicação com franqueados e fornecedores;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de apresentações e materiais técnicos;

  • Familiaridade com Excel e Canva;
  • Noções de Gestão de Projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão, como Trello e Planner;

  • Perfil organizado, com capacidade de gerenciar tarefas e prazos;
  • Agilidade e adaptabilidade em ambientes dinâmicos;

Remuneração: Bolsa Auxílio de R$1.400,00 (passando para R$1.600,00 no último ano de graduação) + Vale Transporte + Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (R$32,00/dia) + GymPass + Plano de Saúde Amil + Auxílio Farmácia OMNI + Convênio Sesc + Convênio com faculdades + Convênio com cursos de idiomas + Chances de Efetivação + Participação no Programa de Estágio + Chances de se tornar Trainee + Trilha de Carreira.

title: assistant marketing manager
description:
Company Description

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

THE HOTEL

Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026.

Located on Ipanema Beach, the hotel will feature 172 rooms and embody the brand's contemporary vision of luxury, experience, and service excellence.

Join the team of talents who will bring this new icon of luxury hospitality in Brazil to life.

Job Description

THE POSITION

The Assistant Marketing Manager - Social Media, Brand & Content supports the hotel's digital presence and brand strategy, managing content and campaigns across social media, websites, OTAs, and CRM platforms. This role plays a key part in shaping the hotel's digital identity, creating engaging content, and supporting the launch of new or renovated properties. The position ensures consistent messaging, guest engagement, and alignment with revenue and brand objectives.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the digital and social media strategy for a new luxury hotel brand, shaping its presence from pre-opening through ongoing operations to express a refined, aspirational, and globally recognized brand identity;
  • Create, curate, and oversee compelling content across social media, digital platforms, and multimedia campaigns, highlighting the hotel's unique services, experiences, and lifestyle;
  • Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across Rooms, F&B, MICE, Spa, and other offerings to drive engagement, brand awareness, and revenue growth;
  • Manage pre-opening initiatives, including website setup, social media launch, and digital campaigns, to generate interest and anticipation ahead of the brand's debut;
  • Monitor digital performance, analyze engagement metrics, and optimize content and campaigns to maximize visibility, interaction, and business results;
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, revenue, and operations teams to ensure integrated strategies, consistent brand messaging, and high-end guest experiences;
  • Maintain a strong brand voice and identity across all digital channels, ensuring storytelling aligns with the hotel's global positioning;
  • Monitor social media trends, digital innovations, and best practices in luxury hospitality marketing to enhance the brand's digital presence/
  • Prepare regular reports on digital performance, KPIs, and campaign results, providing actionable insights to inform strategy and decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or related field;
  • Proven experience in social media management, digital content creation and brand marketing, preferably in luxury hospitality;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. French is a plus;
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and project coordination skills;
  • Deep knowledge of current digital marketing concepts, trends, and innovations, with the ability to apply them strategically to elevate the brand's presence.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, social media management tools, and content creation platforms;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Job Category: Sales & Marketing

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do


You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a Retention Marketing Specialist within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements


What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like


Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits


This is a contract position
Up to 40 hours weekly
Remote Selection Process

The selection process includes a video interview screening, followed by role-specific discussions (possible assessment) and a final leadership conversation.

Commitment to Inclusion


UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON


UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy


Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

title: Coordenador(a) de Controle de Qualidade
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de
Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente

Local de Atuação:
Rio de Janeiro, RJ (Iguá Rio de Janeiro S.A).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar da elaboração do plano anual das atividades relacionadas com o sistema de gestão da qualidade, coordenar o levantamento e análise dos procedimentos existentes;
  • Coordenar, planejar e acompanhar os serviços voltados para avaliar a qualidade da água tratada e distribuída, bem como do efluente das estações de tratamento de esgoto, por meio de análises laboratoriais;
  • Coordenar a área sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando a correta administração de recursos financeiros, administrativos e de pessoal;
  • Dirigir veículos da empresa em caso de necessidade de serviço externo, zelando pela segurança e normas de trânsito estabelecidas.
  • Promover o atendimento e cumprimento das normas e procedimentos Sustentabilidade (Qualidade, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Saúde).

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Química ou Engenharia Ambiental;
  • CNH categoria B definitiva e válida;
  • Experiência com controle de qualidade;
  • Experiência com gestão laboratorial;
  • Experiência com liderança de equipe;
  • Experiência com gestão orçamentária;
  • Domínio no Pacote Office.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • CRQ e/ou CREA ativo;
  • Conhecimento da Norma ISO 9001 e 17025;
  • Conhecimento no sistema LIMS e SAP;
  • Entendimento de tratamento de água e esgoto;
  • Desejável conhecimento no PNQS;
  • Experiência no segmento do saneamento (água e esgoto).

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PcD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação

Informações adicionais

Nossos Benefícios
Aqui, cuidamos das nossas pessoas em todas as etapas da sua jornada como colaborador. Conheça o que oferecemos:

Saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida

  • Plano de Saúde extensivo aos dependentes
  • Plano Odontológico extensivo aos dependentes
  • Serviço de Telemedicina
  • Programa de Saúde Emocional com atendimento psicológico gratuito
  • Vacina da gripe anual sem custo para os colaboradores
  • Programas de prevenção e cuidados com a saúde com acompanhamento de portadores de doenças crônicas e estímulo de hábitos saudáveis
  • Acesso à rede credenciada de estabelecimentos diversos, como academias e estúdios (TotalPass)
  • Rede de parcerias e descontos em produtos e serviços
  • Programas internos de qualidade de vida: Mente Leve (para de saúde emocional), Convivendo (acompanhamento de colaboradores portadores de doenças crônicas) e o Enxuga (programa de estímulo de hábitos saudáveis) e Melhor Maternidade (acompanhamento de colaboradoras e dependentes gestantes, e crianças até 2 anos).
  • Seguro de Vida

Família e Apoio Pessoal

  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (20 dias) estendida.

Alimentação

  • Vale alimentação
  • Refeitório ou vale-refeição (conforme operação)
  • Voucher especial de Natal (em cesta ou cartão alimentação/refeição, dependendo da unidade)

Mobilidade

  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento (conforme política interna e localidade da vaga)

Incentivos Financeiros

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Empréstimo Consignado

Desenvolvimento e Carreira

  • Universidade Corporativa com trilhas de aprendizagem
  • Programas de mentoria pontuais
  • Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com a unidade, cargo ou regime de contratação, seguindo critérios de elegibilidade, entraremos em detalhe.

VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE

Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito:
ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Desde então, nos consolidamos como uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas por meio de nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Atuamos com o compromisso de proporcionar mais qualidade de vida e saúde à população atendida, por meio de um trabalho responsável e de excelência no fornecimento de água tratada e nos serviços de coleta, afastamento e tratamento de esgoto.

Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, com as pessoas, com o meio ambiente, com nossos parceiros e com o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil. Esse propósito guia nossas decisões e reforça, todos os dias, o nosso compromisso em cada gota.

O nosso jeito de ser é marcado por um DNA inovador, que promove um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e repleto de aprendizados, gerando impacto positivo na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito às diferenças fazem parte da nossa cultura, promovendo uma atuação ética, inclusiva e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independentemente de crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos equidade e respeito em nossas equipes e acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação. Já somos mais de
2.800 colaboradores
e seguimos com perspectivas de ir ainda mais longe.

Você já se perguntou qual é o seu propósito e que história deseja escrever para a sua vida e carreira? Sempre sonhou em ter um papel protagonista e impactar positivamente a vida de milhares de pessoas? Aqui, você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

#VemSerIguá

Vamos construir um futuro melhor, Iguá Saneamento.

description:

Your assessment will be based on your technical skills and, later, in your behavioral interview. Please fill out all fields of your application with as much detail as possible, remembering that this is essential for your assessment in the anonymous selection process.

About Air Liquide

Through the passion and diversity of its people, Air Liquide leverages the energy and environmental transition, healthcare changes and digitalization, and delivers greater value to all its shareholders.

Join us for a stimulating experience: you will find a world of learning and development opportunities where creativity is at the heart of what we do, in an open, collaborative and respectful environment.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

é responsável por planejar, coordenar e executar atividades de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos, sistemas e instalações. Este profissional desempenha um papel fundamental para garantir a eficiência operacional, a segurança e a confiabilidade dos ativos da empresa.


• Executar tarefas de manutenção preventiva (PM), de acordo com o cronograma do local;
• Analisar e resolver problemas relacionados ao desempenho dos equipamentos;
• Monitorar os KPIs dos equipamentos;
• Garantir a segurança no trabalho e prevenir acidentes;
• Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em relação à operação dos equipamentos, procedimentos e processos de manutenção, e sugerir mudanças para melhorar a eficiência, a produtividade e a segurança;
• Preparar relatórios e documentos técnicos, tais como ordens de serviço, relatórios de manutenção, etc.;
• Treinar outros técnicos de manutenção quando necessário;
• Coordenar e supervisionar prestadores de serviços de manutenção terceirizados;
• Manter comunicação com outros departamentos, tais como engenharia, produção, qualidade, suprimentos, logística, HSE, finanças, administração, 

Do you have these requirements?

Ensino superior completo em engenharia.

Experiência com manutenção de grande porte

Conhecimento em ferramentas de analise de dados e KPIs

Your differences drive our performance

At Air Liquide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, which means that, regardless of your gender identity, sexual orientation, color, age, religion, nationality or disability, we value a work environment made up of true stories, built by true people. 
Our processes reflect this, being diverse and free from any prejudice, therefore, we do not collect information such as date of birth, gender, marital status or full address in our selection stages. If this information is sent, it will be disregarded. 

We strongly believe that a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively, and helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About Match Affinity
Match Affinity is a division of Match Group that drives the fastest growing dating apps. Every month, millions of users come to our apps, like BLK and Chispa, to find matches and make great connections.
The Role
As a Data Analyst on our Product Analytics Team, you'll use data to understand our users -- what they need, what they do, how to retain them, and ultimately how to help them find the best dates.  Then you will partner with cross-functional teams to provide long-term strategic insights for our products.  You will also support business trends/forecasting and model the financial impact of new product ideas.

What You'll Do

  • A strong knowledge querying massive and complex datasets, analyzing, and driving key and actionable insights
  • Working with other cross-functional teams like Finance, CRM, Engineering and Business Intelligence; proactively engage other teams to identify and drive better user experience
  • Providing internal consulting to product management, marketing, finance, and CRM teams on A/B tests as they move initiatives from concept to market
  • Presenting technical content across business stakeholders
  • Working as the product owner of revenue and retention strategies for the product
  • Serving as the subject matter expert on applying various statistical methodologies towards distilling actionable insights
  • Researching issues about customer behavior/changes by analyzing relevant metrics, trends and supporting enterprise level initiatives
  • Supporting these products: Chispa, BLK, Upward, Yuzu

You might be a Match if you have:

  • 3+ years of hands on SQL (or structured data) experience along with advanced Excel Skills
  • Exposure to applied statistics (descriptive statistics, statistical testing, design of experiments, linear modeling, time series analysis etc); Python/SPSS/SAS/R experience a plus
  • Self-starter with good communications skills
  • You have experience going beyond number-crunching, reports, and dashboard creation -- you are able to understand the business impact of the data and make recommendations based on your findings
  • Excellent problem solving skills
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics,Economics, Computer Science, Engineering related field, Marketing, or MBA with quantitative focus
  • Experience in product analytics supporting digital applications including mobile apps & consumer internet is preferred
  • Fluent English is required.

Import to know:

  • As a global company operating across different time zones, flexibility in working hours will be important for this role.

  • Please submit your CV in English

title: Intern- Rio
description:
Description

ABS Interns are integrated into ABS business operations and will experience various aspects of engineering review, technical problem solving, and/or research and development. Interns will work with a designated advisor to learn and develop skills relating to ABS's core business functions while also assisting ABS with key deliverables. It is expected that interns will be assigned multiple projects for their respective departments throughout the course of their internship. Interns will work at the local ABS Consulting Office. 

What You Will Do:

  • The primary function of an intern is to develop skills and knowledge of ABS core business functions including but not limited to:
    • Engineering Plan Review.
    • Technical Plan Review.
    • Research and Product Development.
    • Operational Safety and Evaluation.
    • Data Science and Digital Services
  • Interns may provide engineering support in the form of design review and analysis assignments typically involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects. Projects will vary in complexity and difficulty.
  • Under the supervision of an experienced engineer or engineering manager, interns may assist with a detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure that the needs of the clients will be met.
  • May propose technical advice to field operations and other technical offices.
  • May propose new approaches to problems encountered and make recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or designs.
  • May assist in the development of business performance metrics including the development and implementation of an ongoing business performance monitoring program, and the periodic analysis of operating results to determine causes, trends, etc.
  • May assist with the writing and presentation of technical papers and reports concerning areas of expertise and work performed.
  • May assist with Rule development projects as assigned.
  • Interns may collaborate with the digital team and with other departments such as services, class, project management, commercial operations, etc.
  • Intern may assist with data collection efforts for data quality improvement, in both existing and new data streams to support overall business goals.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in progress in Chemical Engineering (other related Engineering degrees – e.g., Mechanical, Production, Safety, Process – may be considered).
  • Currently enrolled from the 6th semester (or equivalent) onwards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong interest in risk analysis, process safety and process engineering, especially in sectors such as marine/offshore, oil & gas and mining.
  • Availability to work 30 hours per week (e.g., 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday), during business hours.
  • Intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) – especially Excel for data treatment and KPI/risk indicator analysis.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (and Portuguese).
  • Organization, attention to detail and interest in quality, risk and safety from a systems and process perspective.
  • Analytical mindset and genuine interest in working with data, engineering information and risk scenarios.
  • Proactivity and curiosity to understand client processes, technologies and risk scenarios in marine/offshore, oil & gas, mining and other industrial sectors.
  • Attention to detail and rigor in technical documentation, records and analyses.
  • Teamwork and collaboration, with ability to interact with multidisciplinary technical teams (engineering, operations, safety, quality, etc.).
  • Good organizational skills to manage multiple analytical tasks and deadlines.
  • Ethical behavior, focus on safety and alignment with ABS values of integrity and responsibility.

It would be nice if you had: 

  • Academic or extracurricular experience related to process safety, risk assessment, reliability, process simulation or industrial operations.
  • Basic understanding of risk analysis methods (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP, Bow-tie, LOPA, FMEA) and/or management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO – even if only from university courses.
  • Familiarity with process flowcharts, PFDs, P&IDs and basic process engineering concepts (mass/energy balance, unit operations, etc.).
  • Experience with spreadsheets and basic data analysis (advanced Excel, simple dashboards, basic BI tools) is a plus.

Reporting Relationships:

You'll work alongside engineer colleagues reporting into a Senior Manager. colleguages 

Important: This internship does not involve laboratory activities. It is a position focused on theoretical and analytical work, risk and process evaluation, data analysis and technical documentation.

title: Account Manager
description:
At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
We are looking for an Account Manager to come and join our team, you will work closely with internal functions (Finance, Project Management, Legal, Professional Services) to execute account retention and growth strategies for Zyte's strategic accounts.  

Customer satisfaction, business retention, and portfolio growth are the key drivers of success for this position. 

Requirements

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the lead point of contact for a defined portfolio of existing business accounts.
  • Cultivate meaningful and long-lasting client relationships.
  • Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize profits.
  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders and executive sponsors.
  • Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives.
  • Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders.

title: auxiliar fiscal
description:
Apoiar nos processos fiscais e tributários, garantindo a correta conferência, lançamento e transmissão das obrigações acessórias, assegurando a conformidade fiscal e o cumprimento dos prazos.

Cobrança, Recebimentos, Lançamento de Documentos e Baixa no MG Controle

  • Cobrar os clientes através do MG Controle, no primeiro dia útil do mês, sobre pendências para o fechamento fiscal (SPED, ICMS, SPED Contribuições, energia, produtor rural, XML de saída e notas de serviços);

  • Acompanhamento diário de baixas e recebimentos do MG Controle;

  • Após o envio das pendências, lançar notas de serviço no SUPREMA;

  • Destacar notas com ISS, INSS e IRPCC;

  • Lançar todas as notas de serviço na prefeitura e enviar as guias de ISS para o cliente (SCI Web), conforme a data de vencimento.

Conferência e Liberação de Documentos

  • Conferir os valores do produtor rural do cliente e realizar a troca global de CFOP e das alíquotas;

  • Após conferir os serviços de produtor rural e aluguel, liberar o REINF;

  • Verificar o SPED do cliente, CFOP e mercadorias;

  • Importar o XML de saída para o SUPREMA;

  • Gerar LOG no SUPREMA;

  • Gerar um novo SPED com as devidas conferências;

  • Abrir o PVA e importar o novo SPED;

  • Conferir possíveis inconsistências utilizando o LOG gerado;

  • Comparar a entrada, saída e a apuração com o SUPREMA.

Fechamento Fiscal

  • Validar os dados no SCI e gerar um novo arquivo TXT;

  • Salvar os relatórios de entrada, saída, apuração e TXT na pasta do setor;

  • Acessar o SUPREMA e salvar os seguintes relatórios: configurável, totalizador, ICMS e serviços;

  • Anexar os relatórios no SIS Análise para conferência do gerente de contas;

  • Concluir o fechamento da loja após validação de todos os pontos;

  • Atentar-se aos prazos das obrigações para realizar a baixa no MG Controle.

Contribuições e Transmissão

  • Receber a distribuição do Quinto Passo no final do mês;

  • Salvar o relatório configurável e lançar as informações destacadas no relatório de PIS e COFINS (aluguel, depreciação, energia e receita financeira);

  • Conferir os valores, substituir os relatórios, gerar um novo arquivo TXT e transmiti-lo no MASTERTAX;

  • Após a transmissão, salvar o recibo e dar baixa no MG Controle;

  • Realizar o envio das confirmações de faturamento, LOG de inconsistência de XML e envio da tributação.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar relatórios e dashboards utilizando Business Intelligence (BI) para análise detalhada de dados comerciais, proporcionando insights estratégicos para as equipes de vendas e liderança.

  • Criar análises de tendências de mercado e comportamento do consumidor, com base nos dados coletados, para apoiar decisões comerciais mais assertivas e identificar oportunidades de vendas.

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia de Produção, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.

Resumo da Vaga
Responsável por atuar como ponto focal em Privacidade de Dados e Governança de TI na companhia, atuando para a conformidade com a LGPD, orientando e influenciando o DPO nas iniciativas de privacidade, conduzindo a governança de acessos e perfis no ambiente SAP, realizando treinamentos, gerenciando o portal de titulares e mantendo atualizados os registros de tratamento de dados (ROPA) e as avaliações de impacto (DPIA/PIA).

Atuar e monitorar o nível de conformidade do Grupo Profarma à LGPD, realizando o monitoramento da conformidade com a LGPD, auxiliando a companhia na coleta de informação para identificar atividades e processamento de dados, fornecer conselhos e orientações sobre as melhores práticas de conformidade;

Realizar auditorias internas de aderência de processos e sistemas à LGPD, planejando e executando trabalhos de auditoria de Governança de Dados, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação e Compliance Digital e Legal;

Contribuir para que todas as áreas implementem os planos de ação visando o pleno atendimento da LGPD, realizando a descrição do cenário atual, desenhando como são as atividades detalhadas dos processos e das áreas envolvidas em trabalhos de auditoria LGPD, gerando planos de ação e acompanhando sua implementação;

Supervisionar o Registro de atividades de Processamento (RoPA), estabelecendo a realização de manutenção do registro de processamento de dados através de monitoramento contínuo;

Implementar políticas, normas, termos, citações, procedimentos e relatórios de impacto à privacidade de dados, revisando e aconselhando sobre políticas de privacidade, procedimentos e documentação relacionada ao tratamento de dados pessoais;

Realizar treinamentos, conscientização e aculturamento sobre a LGPD, promovendo ações de treinamento e capacitação quanto a LGPD;

Atuar em projetos que tenham interface com a área de Segurança da Informação, intermediando e sendo ponto focal em projetos que envolvam a área de Privacidade de Dados e Segurança da Informação;

Administrar o portal de titulares de dados, administrando o recebimento, análise e resposta às solicitações de titulares de dados, garantindo prazos legais e registro adequado das interações, monitorando indicadores de atendimento de solicitações (SAC, DSR, DSAR);

Conduzir a governança de acessos e perfis no ambiente SAP, implementando e revisando perfis de acesso com foco em segurança, compliance e aderência à LGPD, atuando em conjunto com TI e Auditoria para mitigar riscos relacionados a acessos;

Influenciar decisões estratégicas do DPO e da alta liderança, fornecendo análises de risco, pareceres técnicos e recomendações estratégicas sobre privacidade e governança de TI, participando de comitês e fóruns de governança para promover cultura de privacidade.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Buy Box Experts (BBE) is a Spreetail Agency, our mission at BBE is to be premier Amazon strategists by successfully evolving and adapting to the ever-changing environment that is Amazon and e-commerce. Our strategic growth mindset and holistic approach encourage forward-thinking and provide the greatest potential for success for our Brand Partners.

We're looking for a Creative Strategist with 2-3 years of experience in e-commerce marketing and creative strategy to develop compelling brand narratives, drive conversion-focused projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate has strong writing and communication skills, can distill complex information into clear messaging, and understands design principles and industry trends.

How you will achieve success:

    • Develop strategic narratives, experience design, and technical storytelling to shape brand messaging.
  • Research, conceptualize, and execute creative ideas that align with client and industry visions.
  • Translate audience insights into actionable strategies, marketing initiatives, and engagement tactics.
  • Conduct industry and competitor research to identify trends, opportunities, and challenges.
  • Collaborate with teams to create compelling narratives, immersive experiences, and data-driven strategies.

What experiences will help you in this role:

    • Please make sure to submit your resume/CVs in English.
  • Required:
  • 2-3 years of experience in e-commerce marketing and creative strategy.
  • Strong project management, writing, and communication skills.
  • Ability to distill complex information and conduct qualitative analysis.
  • Experience with design principles, cross-functional collaboration, and third-party partnerships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite.
  • Preferred: Experience with Amazon Seller/Vendor Central and Adobe Creative Suite.

We considers candidates who meet the specific job qualifications, whether they are located near our Lehi, UT office or have the ability to work remotely.

Please visit to learn more about us.

ABOUT BUY BOX EXPERTS

Buy Box Experts, a Spreetail Agency, is a premier Amazon marketing agency, supporting brand executives as they seek to CONTROL and GROW their Amazon channel businesses (in the US and internationally).

We help our brand clients develop channel management strategies that reduce price erosion issues, and align marketing efforts with the brand's overall brand vision. We provide full platform account management (1P retail, 3P marketplace and hybrid) incorporating inventory management, listing optimization, advertising campaign management (including AMS, DSP), and customer service. We also operate traffic-building campaigns external to Amazon, designed to drive high-converting traffic to Amazon. We conduct Amazon channel due diligence for private equity and investors looking to acquire brands that depend heavily on Amazon as a sales channel.

Our leadership team is very focused on building a company culture focused on being inclusive, encouraging open discussion of issues, and developing the team through a growth-based mindset. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

A Autoescola Dois Irmãos está selecionando dois profissionais para integrar sua equipe de atendimento na unidade de Laranjeiras. Buscamos perfis com forte viés comercial, excelente dicção e agilidade no uso de sistemas digitais.

Localização: Rua das Laranjeiras, 17 - Laranjeiras, Rio de Janeiro - RJ.

Horários Disponíveis:

  • (Abertura): Segunda a Sexta, das 07h às 16h.
  • (Fechamento): Segunda a Sexta, das 13h às 22h.
  • Sábados: Jornada de 4 horas para ambos os turnos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar o atendimento presencial e telefônico focado na conversão de matrículas e vendas de serviços.
  • Operar sistemas de agendamento de aulas e exames.
  • Suporte administrativo básico via Pacote Office (Word/Excel).
  • Garantir a organização e o padrão de excelência na recepção da autoescola.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em atendimento ao público e vendas.
  • Fluência verbal e escrita clara e profissional.
  • Conhecimento básico de informática (Excel e Word).
  • Experiência com softwares de agendamento será um diferencial.

Remuneração e Benefícios:

  • Salário: R$ 1.720,00.
  • Benefícios: Vale-transporte + Cartão iFood Benefícios.

Tipo de vaga: Efetivo CLT

Pagamento: R$1.621,00 - R$1.720,00 por mês

Benefícios:

  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte

title: vendedor externo
description:
Descrição
VAGA NA CORRETORA PARCEIRA
Empresa VITAL LATINA corretora parceira da Sinaf Seguros está em expansão e está contratando Vendedor Externo

Buscamos candidatos apaixonados por vendas e prontos para fazer a diferença. Esse é você? Então venha fazer parte de uma equipe de sucesso e conquiste seus sonhos

solidez e compromisso

Promover ações regulares de relacionamento com os clientes ativos ou não da sua carteira;

Organização, disciplina, determinação e constância

Gostar de trabalhar com venda externa e por telefone

Ter como objetivo ganhos acima de 3 mil reais em 2 anos

Desejável vivência em vendas
